'''Jarik Vuintor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]], who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Vuintor was a member of [[Truth For Cularin]], an organization that produced a number of documentaries about the various problems in the Cularin system. Vuintor narrated one such documentary about the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was active in the system. In it, he claimed that they were a major threat to the system and that they were being funded by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Almas Academy]] and [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], Cularin's [[Senator/Legends|senator]].
